name: Pot marigold
intro: Calendula bears yellow or orange heads. This game uses orange flowers to distinguish it from the daisy.
observe: Leaves are oblong to lance-shaped. Flower heads can be single or double.
habitat: Likes sun and good drainage. Heat and drought can reduce performance; light summer shade can help.
fact: Removing spent flower heads encourages more flowers. It can also self-seed in the garden.
